scope: Manual atomic reading inventory after complete reading of four original-pin overviews and before this followup current-owner reads. Earlier project context is known; not a blind review. These28clauses support seven existing aggregate points, not a replacement/addition to the original6827-point denominator.

requirements.requirement: Keep material amount, ongoing flux and survival dependence separate, including whether the direction of the finding was tested.
Use perturbation and controls to distinguish mechanisms; a coherent pathway experiment does not establish patient benefit.
DNA coverage/detection of sequence or copy changes does not establish downstream consequence.
Captured messages/transcript forms and their cell source depend on mixture, preparation and background.
Protein presence, location and activation are different from survival dependence.
A location measurement alone does not establish immune recognition or killing.
A response under a defined model perturbation may not transfer to the clinical setting.
Repeated blood measurements keep sampling, shedding and sensitivity with the detected tumour-derived signal.
Mechanism, clinical benefit and eligibility require distinct evidence; agreement is not automatically drug response.
An observed layer, a model inference and an interpreted conclusion are different measured objects/claims.
Epithelial describes a family that includes normal cells; malignant assignment requires additional evidence.
Computational pseudobulk pools counts from a selected cell group; preserve the group, denominator, normalization and reference comparison.
A luminal-progenitor-like RNA program is a reference resemblance, not proof of developmental origin or a clinical receptor category.
Record collection site/time, treatment context and analyzed cells/material; core and resection sample different amounts/arrangements.
Keep molecular object, units, assay version and threshold beside the value.
Preparation, accepted input, tissue consumption and sample attribution constrain valid comparison.
DNA/RNA/protein layer and cell/spatial resolution are different axes, including mixed tissue versus recovered cells/nuclei and regions.
Adding location at a stated resolution does not automatically add a protein or functional measurement.
Resolution, coverage and detection sensitivity are distinct limits; a detailed map is not a complete inventory.
Distinguish signed clinical findings, preliminary results, research observations, model predictions and interpreted claims with validation and uncertainty.
Name controls/reference/normalization or prior timepoint and check preparation/sample compatibility.
Preserve coverage, detection/sampling limits and the unmeasured bridge; image-predicted RNA is not directly measured RNA.
Name the actual decision, relevant validated biomarker-treatment connection, setting and eligibility rather than infer a treatment from mechanism.
The invented example is one pretreatment breast-biopsy region with normal/malignant mixture, geneR bulk RNA and normalized comparison units; it does not sample another site.
Unresolved RNA cell origin and absent malignant-cell membrane-protein measurement leave accessible target, normal-tissue selectivity and dependence open.
High belongs to the stated compatible reference/normalization; a further broad RNA result need not answer the missing location question.
Keep the six-question chain specimen, measurement, evidence status, comparison, limit and decision, distinguishing a research followup from validated treatment eligibility.
A gene signal predicted from a tissue image remains a model prediction with validation/uncertainty, not directly assayed RNA.

exclusions: Front matter, navigation/directory scaffolding, learning-time estimates, repeated recaps and personal-case routing remain noncredit. No personal-case text, care findings or private destinations are copied into OnCo. Later same-path absence is not global content absence.
